question: Are v8's initial, source-attention, and MLP-write variable groups operationally interchangeable between matched lexical and fresh constructions under the same downstream recurrence?

novelty_search.result: Existing aspectual work transfers whole programs and a final carrier but has not exchanged explicit pre-resid18 variable groups between matched constructions.

frozen_design.population: All 32 lexical and 32 fresh A1/A2 rows, bijectively matched by family, reporter, object_name, and direction_id; each row is target once and source is its match in the other panel.

group_definitions.attention: role-projected block11 and block15 source-attention deltas
group_definitions.mlp: the explicit block11/12/14/15 base/hybrid state tuples consumed by the released bilinear factors

frozen_design.swap_semantics: Each swap arm starts from the target full v8 program and replaces exactly one named variable group with the matched source group's tensors. source_full supplies all three source groups. Global lambdas, Down weights, exact recurrence, base-resid18 readout, target answer/foil IDs, and target outcome denominator remain target-side/common.

predictions.pred_a_authority_pairing_capability_and_: Hashes, row authorities, exact bijection, all native capability cells, manual base replay, and writer/MLP reconstruction controls pass.
predictions.pred_b_target_program_effect: target_full has positive mean recovery and at least 0.75 direction in lexical/fresh A1/A2.
predictions.pred_c_whole_variable_transfer: source_full retains at least 0.50 of target_full mean recovery and 0.75 direction in every panel.
predictions.pred_d_groupwise_operational_equivalence: swap_initial, swap_attention, and swap_mlp each retain at least 0.75 of target_full mean recovery and 0.75 direction in every panel.
predictions.pred_e_exact_coverage_and_price: All 320 intervention records are unique within 72 counted forwards, 576 example evaluations, and zero fit/backward/update.

terminal.screen: A-E pass: all three explicit variable groups are construction-interchangeable under the registered downstream reader.
terminal.null: Authority, target effect, and coverage pass, but whole-source or at least one named group fails operational interchange; retain the first failing group as construction-specific.
terminal.invalid: Authority, pairing, native capability, reconstruction control, target program effect, or coverage fails.
